definitions.explanation: A person who has withdrawn from active work or public life to live quietly. Traditionally referred to a household head who had handed over authority to a successor.
A person who has chosen to withdraw from society and live a quiet, secluded life, often with connotations of contentment and simplicity.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}として{静|しず}かに{暮|く}らしている。
examples.english: My grandfather lives quietly as a retired person.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}を{引退|いんたい}した{父|ちち}は、すっかり{隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}になった。
examples.english: My father, who retired from the company, has become a complete retiree.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}は{隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}になるつもりはなく、ボランティアで{活動|かつどう}したい。
examples.english: After retirement age, I don't plan to become a recluse — I want to stay active through volunteer work.

examples.japanese: {山奥|やまおく}に{住|す}む{隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}のような{生活|せいかつ}に{憧|あこが}れる。
examples.english: I long for a life like a recluse living deep in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世間|せけん}から{離|はな}れた{隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}のように{見|み}えるが、{実|じつ}はネットで{活発|かっぱつ}に{情報|じょうほう}{発信|はっしん}している。
examples.english: He looks like a recluse cut off from the world, but he's actually very active online sharing information.

examples.japanese: {江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}の{隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}は{家督|かとく}を{譲|ゆず}った{後|あと}、{趣味|しゅみ}に{没頭|ぼっとう}する{人|ひと}も{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: In the Edo period, many retirees devoted themselves to hobbies after handing over the family headship.

notes:
A compound of {隠居|いんきょ} (retirement, seclusion) and {人|にん} (person). In premodern Japan, {隠居|いんきょ} specifically meant the formal act of a household head ({家長|かちょう}) transferring authority and property to a successor. The word {隠居人|いんきょにん} can carry either a positive nuance of peaceful retirement or a slightly negative implication of being idle and disengaged.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}のような{生活|せいかつ}: a reclusive lifestyle
- {隠居|いんきょ}{人|にん}になる: to become a retiree/recluse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {隠居|いんきょ}: retirement, seclusion — the act or state itself, not the person
- {引退者|いんたいしゃ}: retired person — a more modern, neutral term
- {年金|ねんきん}{生活者|せいかつしゃ}: pensioner — focuses on living on a pension
